conbody.p: The iirds-subjectscheme transformation accepts native RDF/XML or the bundled schemas/iirds-1.3.xml manifest. It runs directly on RDF and bypasses DITA preprocessing.

The output is taxonomy/subjectscheme.ditamap. All five official 1.3 schemas are represented: Core, Machinery, Software, Handover and SKOS annotations. Class keys and property keys are vocabulary references; instance keys assign metadata.

The shipped combined scheme is subjectscheme/iirds-generated-subjectscheme.ditamap. Use it for authoring metadata across domain boundaries. A generated scheme for an individual schema may refer to classes declared in Core; combine it with Core or use the complete manifest.
Use --iirds.language=de for German labels. The default is English. SKOS preferred labels and definitions take precedence, with RDFS fallback.

The separate iirds-schema-html native transformation produces index.html and schema.css for a readable vocabulary reference. Override its stylesheet URL with --iirds.schema.css=URL. These native transformations do not generate iiRDS publication archives.
The older Java taxonomy extractor remains in the test sources as a historical developer utility. The supported local command is the native transformation above.
